name: Wind & Flame: Special'nyj epizod
source:
What surprises does the spookiest day of the year hold?
It's time to find out and have some fun! But don't forget that Halloween entertainment should be chosen wisely. After all, things could end with rather unpleasant consequences...
translation:
一年中最令人毛骨悚然的日子，会带来哪些惊喜？
是时候一探究竟，尽情玩乐了！不过别忘了，万圣节的娱乐活动可得谨慎挑选。毕竟，一不小心，就可能以相当不愉快的后果收场……
